sentences.text: Appearance:
Shri Umesh Sharma, learned counsel for the applicant.
Shri Viraj Godha, learned G.A. for the State.
Shri Nitin Parashar, learned counsel for the Objector  ORDER Heard with the aid of case diary.

This is first application filed under Section 483 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 (in short "BNSS"), for grant of bail to the applicant/accused, relating to FIR/Crime No.104/2024 dated (not mentioned) registered at Police Station-Jiwajiganj, District-Ujjain (M.P.) for commission of offence punishable under Sections 376(2)(N) and 506 of the IPC.
2. Prosecution story, in brief is that, there was friendship between prosecutrix and applicant.

On 15.02.2023, applicant told the prosecutrix that he loves her and wanted to marry her therefore,
prosecutrix started to live with the applicant.
Both of them lived together for a longtime in a rented room at different places.

On 18.04.2024, when the prosecutrix told the applicant to solemnized marriage with her then he denied and threatened her NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2024:MPHC-IND:23391 2 MCRC-31711-2024 that if she lodged report against him then he will kill her.
Matter was reported on 26.04.2024.
3. Learned counsel for the applicant/accused submits that the applicant has not committed the offence and he has falsely been implicated in the case.
It is submitted that prosecutrix is a major lady aged around 25 years.
Applicant never promised to marry the prosecutrix.

The prosecutrix was Wasim vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 14 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/99766510/

sentences.text: She live with the applicant for a long time meanwhile, she never reported the mater.
FIR was lodged belatedly without any cogent reasons.
It is submitted that applicant is in custody since 26.06.2024.
Investigation is completed and charge sheet has been filed.

Conclusion of trial will take considerable long time for its disposal, therefore, it is prayed that the applicant be released on bail.
4.

On the other hand, learned counsel for the non-applicant/State as well as counsel for the Objector opposed the prayer and counsel for the Objector also submits that family member of the applicant are pressuring to compromise the matter.
On 31.07.2024, when the prosecutrix was returning from Nanakheda Sabji Mandi then brother of the applicant Asif Kureshi and three other persons stopped her and abused her in filthy language.
They threatened the prosecutrix to compromise the matter therefore, applicant is not entitled for grant of bail.

5. Having considered the rival submissions and after perusal of the case diary so also considering the facts and circumstances of the case, without commenting on the merits of the case, this Court is of the view that applicant deserves to be enlarged on bail hence, the application is allowed.
NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2024:MPHC-IND:23391 3 MCRC-31711-2024 6.
It is directed that the applicant- WASIM

be released on bail upon his/her furnishing personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the concerned trial Court for his/her appearance before the trial Court on all such dates as may be fixed in this behalf by the trial Court during pendency of the trial.
It is further directed that applicant shall comply with the provisions of Section Section 480(3) of The Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023.
7. Applicant shall not to pressurize the prosecutrix and other acquainted persons.
He is further directed to appear before the concerned court for hearing of the case regularly.
8. In violation of the conditions as mentioned above, prosecutrix or State may file application for cancellation of bail.
9. This order shall be effective till the end of trial but in case of bail jump, it shall become ineffective.
10. With the aforesaid, this application is allowed and stands disposed of.
Certified copy, as per Rules.
